msContents.summary: According to the catalog entry, this manuscript contains stories 1–3, and then again 1–20.

support.p: Extent and leaf dimensions from the catalog entry.

lg.l: kathayaṃtaṃ hi nānārthan_ prabhāvānadbhutāṃs tathā |

romaśaṃ dharma
tatvajñaṃ | paryapṛchad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
yo rakṣet prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhayārtaṃ śaraṇagataṃ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat syā tan me brūhi tapodhana |

ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve
samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhitasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ |
atraivodāharaṃtimam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |

iṃdraśyāgneś ca saṃvā
daṃ śiber auśīnarasya ca |
vartamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śibiṃ nṛpaṃ |

iṃdraḥ śyenaḥ kakapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropaja
gmatuḥ |
uṃ nṛpatiṃ prāpya kapotaḥ śyenajād bhayāt |
śaraṇārthi mahīpālaṃ vililye bhayavihvalaḥ |

tataḥ śanair u
pāgamya śyenarūpi sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ taṃ mahātmānaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā |
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatatparaḥ |

sa
daiva vihito bhakṣyaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā |
mahāṃs tvaṃ dharmabudhyā tu mā dharmaṃ kartum arhasi |

santra
starūpaḥ prāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ |
matsakāśam anuprāptaṃ prāṇagrudhnurayaṃ janaḥ |
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasyābhayārthinaḥ |

katham asma
dvidhā | kuryus tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ |
lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yas tyajec charaṇaṃ gataṃ |
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasya pāpam āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |

śāstre
ṣu niṣkṛtir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahaṃtus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit |

ya ātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ ta
thā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarārogair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |

jantavaḥ parikliśyaṃte
mṛtyos trasyaṃti te tava |
yannimittaṃ bhavec chokas trāso vā krodha eva vā |

āyāso vā yato mūlaṃ ekaṃgam api saṃ
tyajet |
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ na kasyoparijāyate |
jñeyas tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ |

yathā ca te
jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |
tvaṃ rakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā | tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ |
tasmāṃ nāham imaṃ bhītam arpayiṣye kapotakaṃ |
yad atra yukta manyatte karttuṃ śyenāśu tad vada |
āhārāt sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti nareśvara |

āhāreṇe
va vardhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jantavaḥ |
śakyate duṣkare py arthe cirarātrāya jīvituṃ |
na tv āhāravihīne na śakyaṃ varthayituṃ kvacit |

kṣyād vilopitasyān manmama prā
viṣāṃ pate |
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti panthānam apunarbhavaṃ |
mṛte ca mayi sarvam ca putradāraṃ mariṣyati |

rakṣyamāṇaḥ kapo
taṃ tvaṃ bahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi |
dharmaṃ yo bādhate dharmo na sa dharmaḥ paraṃtapa |
avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmmas sadbhir ucyate |

tasmā
d virodhe dharmasya viciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ |
yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru dharmaviniścayaṃ |

bahukalyā
ṇasaṃyuktaṃ babhāṣe vihagottama |
suparṇaḥ pakṣirāṭ_ tvaṃ ca dharmaṃ jñātvā ca bhaṣase |

nāto bhūyas tato dharmaḥ
kaścid anyo sti khecara |
prāṇināṃ prāṇabhītānāṃ abhayaṃ yaḥ prayachati |
varam ekasya satvasya pradattaṃ jīvitābhayaṃ |
viprasahasrasya gosahasraṃ dine dine |
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayā paraḥ |

mahatām api yajñānāṃ tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣaya
eva na vidyate |
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāras sulabhā bhuvi |
durlabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ |
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyyate phalaṃ |
bhītābhayapradātasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |
dattam iṣṭaṃ tapas taptaṃ tīrthaṃ vedo śrutaṃ tathā |>

sarvāṇy abhayadānasya
kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ |
catussāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ |

abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo tayyor abhayado
dhikaḥ |
api tyaje rājyam idaṃ | śarīraṃ vā pi dustyajaṃ |
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakaṃ |

yan mamāsti śubhaṃ
kincit purā janmani janmani |
bhavet trātā hayārthānām ārtināśāya dehināṃ |

na cāhaṃ kāmaye rājyaṃ na sva
rgaṃ vā punarbhavaṃ |
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ |
yathā hi nānṛtā vācam aham em udiraye |
satyenānena bhagavān prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ |
āhārārthaṃ ihāraṃbho tava cāraṃ vihaṃgama |
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyad eva dadāmy ahaṃ |

ya e
va vihito smākaṃ | dātrā bhakṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ |
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryam asty aparair mama |
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |

mā rājan_ sāratāṃ
jñātvā kadaḷīstaṃddham āruha |
nāhaṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvad varte vihaṃgama |

śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmmaśre
vadayāparaḥ |
sarvabhūteṣu yad dānaṃ ekasatve dayāparaḥ |
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikasmin viśiṣyate |

sarve vedā na ta
t kuryu sarvayajñāś ca khecara |
sarvatīrthābhiṣekaś ca yat kuryyāt prāṇināṃ dayā |

vāṅmanaḥkarmmabhir ye tu sarvasatvahi
te ratāḥ |
dayādarśitapaṃthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te |
gached asvapato vāpi jāgratas tu vato pi vā |

yan na
bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ |
jaṃgamādini bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |

atmavat parirakṣaṃti parirakṣanti te yāṃti pa
ramāṃ gatiṃ |
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ |

rājyaṃ śibīnāṃ sakalaṃ prayachāmi tava
dvija |
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjayitvā kapotakaṃ |
yadi rājan_ kapote te sudṛḍhā bhaktir īdṛśī |

yataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha
me |
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyeśenābhiyācase |
etat te haṃ pravakṣyāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi |
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |
dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ |

yadi prāṇyupakārāya
deho yaṃ nopayujyate |
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā |

nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava
māṃsaṃ nareśvara |
tasmāt kapotasadṛśaṃ prayacha tulayā dhṛtaṃ |

tadaivāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śye
nābhibhāṣase |
śyenasya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt tad dāsye haṃ vihaṃgama |
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samuddhṛtya sa pārtthivaḥ |

prahṛ
ṣṭas tulayāmāsa kapotena samaṃ prabhuḥ |
dhrayyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatricyate |
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsani tataḥ hasan_ prādāt sa pārthivaḥ |

na vidya
te mayā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |
pakṣiṇo khilamāṃso sā ārūroha svamaṃ tulāṃ |
atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpa |

devaduṃdubha
yo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca |
tato sya tāṃ tadā matvā dharme buddhiṃ sudurlabhāṃ |

śākraḥ svarūpam āsthāya vākyam eta
d uvāca ha |
iṃdro ham iha bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāhanaḥ |

jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājan_ imaṃ yajñam upāga
tau |
netat pūrve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare |
mahākāruṇikeneha yat kṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ tvayā |

parārthe tyaja
taḥ prāṇān_ yā prītir abhavat tava |
yā prītiprāṇalubdheṣu na sā prāneṣu dehināṃ |

parāthaikāṃtakalyāṇā svāśra
yātyaṃtaniṣṭhurā |
tvayy eva kevalā rājan_ kurute karuṇāpadaṃ |

svakarmapāśais sudṛḍhaṃ baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idaṃ ja
gat |
tvaṃ rājan_ duḥkhamohārthe baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa |
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati |

sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yato nā
vartate punaḥ |
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā |
paśavo pi hi jīvaṃti kevalātmodaraṃbharāḥ |
puvāmān bhavati ślāghyo yaḥ parārthaṃ hi jīvati |
kiṃ cātra citraṃ t saṃtaḥ parānugrahatatparāḥ |

na hi svadehaśaityā
ya jāyaṃte caṃdanadrumāḥ |
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāpagataspṛhāḥ |

jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ā
dṛśā bhuvi |
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ca medinīṃ |
sarvalokān atikramya brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi |

viciṃ
tya rājā svaśarīram adhruvaṃ yaśas tu sarvasya janasya durlabhaṃ |

śarīradānāt parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhū
ṣaṇaṃ yayau | |

body.p: itītihāsasamuccaye śyenakapoto khyānaṃ nāma caturtho dhyayaḥ ||
